summary.text: Warren Daniel is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who represents District 46 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney and U.S. Military Academy graduate, he served in the U.S. Army from 1991 to 1997.

paragraphs.text: Warren Daniel graduated from the United States Military Academy in 1991 with a B.S. in national security and public affairs and was commissioned as a second lieutenant in the Army Field Artillery, according to Ballotpedia.
He later transitioned to reserve status and earned his J.D. from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, and he began practicing law at the Daniel Law Firm in 2000.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists Daniel as chair of the Appropriations on Justice and Public Safety, Appropriations/Base Budget and Judiciary committees, vice chair of Rules and Operations of the Senate, and a member of the Finance and Pensions and Retirement and Aging committees.
